6. A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than `now`. Call `schedule_callback` with the date and the time, then close as `not_reached` / `callback`.

bands.quote: | 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1 |
| 8 to 45 | late | the 7th business day after today | 2 |

floor_fields.quote: 25. The **floor** is `minimum_payment` for a credit card and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan.

identity_fields.quote: 11. Ask two security questions, one at a time: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file. Call `verify_identity` with the answer. Send a date of birth as `YYYY-MM-DD`, whatever way the customer said it. The service rejects anything it cannot read as a date. Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.

wrong_answer_limit.quote: 12. A wrong answer may be asked again. Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.

noncounting_hints.quote: 13. If the customer gives day and month the other way round, `verify_identity` returns `hint: "day_month_swapped"`. Ask them to say the month as a word. That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

promise_attempt_limit.quote: 37. Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`. If it fails, try once more. If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`.

max_products.quote: 1. `get_account` returns one to three products. Each has its own `past_due`, `days_late` and floor.

notes_enabled.quote: 8. The customer may promise some products and refuse others. For each product without a promise call `add_note` with that `product_id` and a reason: `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid` or `service_error`. This also applies when no product gets a promise.

10. A restructuring request still transfers the call (Brief A rule 41). Promises recorded before the request stay. Promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded. Close as `transferred` / `restructuring`. On any transfer (restructuring, support, human) add no notes at all, before or after it.

outcomes.quote: | `promise` | none | at least one promise was recorded |

The outcome table of Brief A applies. With no promise recorded: if every product is noted `paid`, close as `paid`. Otherwise close as `no_promise` with the reason of the first product, in `get_account` order, whose note is not `paid`. With several products, `promise` wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except rule 10 above.

note_reasons.quote: 8. The customer may promise some products and refuse others. For each product without a promise call `add_note` with that `product_id` and a reason: `refused`, `hardship`, `dispute`, `paid` or `service_error`. This also applies when no product gets a promise.
11. If one `create_promise` fails twice, keep the promises that were recorded and call `add_note` with reason `service_error` for the failed product.

transfer_queues.quote: 32. If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the customer support team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` and close as `transferred` / `support`. If they decline, close as `no_promise` / `hardship`. This rule comes before rules 30 and 41. If the customer still names a date or an amount themselves, record the promise under sections 7 and 8.
41. A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan. Call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructuring` and close as `transferred` / `restructuring`.
42. A request for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `general` and close as `transferred` / `human`.
